title: Income Tax: removing the pensions tax two-year rule
text:
Tax-free lump sum death benefits will no longer be taxed just because they are not paid within 2 years of the pension scheme administrator first learning of the member’s death.

 The same 2-year tax rule will also be removed for:

 • annuity payments from a drawdown fund

 • money put into drawdown in pension schemes outside the UK following a person’s death

attachments.title: Tax treatment of pension and lump sum death benefits under the two-year rule
